device.description: Automotive battery-monitoring AFE: two 24-bit 64 kSPS delta-sigma current ADCs, two 16-bit multiplexed sequenced ADCs, two 24-bit voltage ADCs, SPI interface
device.note: ads131b26-q1.pdf (SBASA22B) p.4-5 pin functions (Table 4-1), p.7 recommended operating conditions, p.15-16 timing (Figure 5-1: CPOL 0, CPHA 1), p.34 output codes (Table 7-7), p.56-58 operating and conversion modes, p.65-77 serial interface (frames, words, STATUS word, commands Table 7-25, DRDYn), p.79-85 register map (Table 8-1), p.86-234 register fields

registers.name: ID
registers.note: REV[7:0] and DEVICE_ID[4:0] reset X (not specified): 0 used; ADC_COUNT = 110b

registers.name: STATUS_MSB
registers.note: bits 15:11 are write-1-to-restore fault flags (stored as written in the model); COMMAND_RESPONSE and LOCK are set by the commands

registers.name: CONVERSION_CTRL
registers.note: STARTA/STARTB/SEQ2x_START always read back 0 (readOnly here; the start trigger sees the written value)

commands.name: NULL
commands.note: command word, then the command CRC word (not checked)

commands.name: RESET
commands.note: latched at the last SCLK of the output CRC word: modeled at CS rise; COMMAND_RESPONSE returns to its reset value 1001b

commands.name: LOCK
commands.note: lock state shown in STATUS; RESET/WREG are not blocked in the model

commands.name: WREG
commands.note: single write to CONVERSION_CTRL (09h) with STOPA = 1 and no START bit: stops continuous conversions (both sections share one conversion engine); the STOP bit itself is not stored

commands.name: WREG
commands.note: command, command CRC, register data (16 bits MSB-aligned in a 24-bit word), register data CRC (not checked); only the first register of a multi-register write (nnn > 0) is written

commands.name: RREG
commands.note: next frame: STATUS, then each register as 16 data bits + its 8-bit address; only the first register is modeled, then zeros

pages: p.4-5 (pins), p.7 (ROC), p.10 (oscillators 8.192 MHz), p.15-16 (timing), p.34 (format), p.56-58 (modes, Equation 19), p.65-77 (interface, commands), p.79-85 (register map), p.86-234 (fields)
notModeled: all analog functions: ADC1y current, ADC2y multiplexed 16-bit sequencer (SEQ2y_STEPn_CFG/DATA stored only; SEQ2y_START/STOP no effect; sequence results stay 0 = the 0 V code), ADC3y voltage, gains, muxes, offset/gain calibration, global chop, test DACs, open-wire current sources
SPI CRCs: the command CRC and WREG data CRC are not checked (the real device executes nothing on a CRC mismatch); the output CRC word is shifted as zeros; register-map / memory-map CRCs read 0
WORD_LENGTH 32-bit frames (only the default 24-bit words are modeled)
multi-register WREG (nnn > 0) and RREG (n nnnn > 0): only the first register (registers in separate padded words cannot be expressed); RREG of an invalid address echoes the address instead of 00h

LOCK enforcement (only STATUS_MSB.LOCK changes), the two-frame RREG frame counter (COMMAND_RESPONSE 0101b / 1100b), error responses 1010b / 1011b / 1101b, SCLK counter, SPI timeout and REG_ACCESS / SPI_CRC / SPI_TIMEOUT / SCLK_COUNT fault flags (stay 1 = no fault)

the two sections A and B share one conversion engine: STARTA or STARTB starts it, STOPA or STOPB stops it; the conversion time and mode follow ADC1A_ADC3A_CFG (OSR13A, CONV_MODE13A) only; DRDY_CTRL, ADCxy_EN enables and the conversion/sequence counters in STATUS_LSB are not modeled

conversion time at the 8.192 MHz internal oscillator (fMOD 4.096 MHz): single-shot = tSETTLE = (3 OSR + 44) tMOD, continuous = OSR / fMOD (the first continuous conversion's longer settling time is not modeled); external CLK / CLK_SOURCE
OP_MODE standby / power-down (stored only), DRDYn held low during reset and the 4 tMCLK high pulse before a new DRDYn falling edge, DRDYn staying low when ADC3B data were not read

supply, clock and digital monitors, fault flags, masks, FAULT pin, missing-host detection (MHD), overcurrent comparators (OCCA/OCCB pins), GPIOs and PWM I/O (registers stored only; GPIO pins never driven)
RESETn internal pulldown (a floating RESETn holds the real device in reset; the model treats Z as inactive); tREGACQ / tPOR
STATUS_MSB fault bits 15:11 write-1-to-restore semantics (stored as written)
variants: ADS131B26-Q1 only in ads131b26-q1.pdf; related ADS131B02-Q1 / ADS131B23 have their own data sheets
